notes: The universal state-curriculum blueprint, generalized from the Louisiana OS: five tracks every U.S. state can run, each localized by the States app through the state fact base (data/states/states.json) — the water anchor, the working corridor, the table, the culture, and the storm memory of the learner's own state. Every transfer check is phrased against 'your state' and performed on its real material: its rivers, its industries, its harvest, its music, its disaster history. The blueprint is the constant; the state is the variable — exactly the pattern the Willie L. Brown Jr. Institute localizer established for the civic tracks.

themes.description: Hurricane, tornado, wildfire, blizzard, quake, flood — every state has a signature hazard, and naming it is the first preparation.

themes.description: Go or stay, meet where, carry what — the one-page household plan your state's hazard demands.
